`aws_quicksight_dashboard` -- real, typed bindings generated directly from the
`hashicorp/aws` provider schema, in every SDK language.

Every tab below is a complete, runnable program, not a fragment,
real enough to save and run exactly as shown.

## Example

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Go">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
    	quicksight "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-aws/sdk/go/aws/quicksight"
    	ubx "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-go/runtime"
    )

    func main() {
    	ubx.Main(ubx.Stack("payments", func() {
    		ubx.Intent(ubx.IntentInfo{Summary: "payments own dashboard"})

    		ubx.Resource(quicksight.Dashboard, "ci-runner", quicksight.DashboardConfig{
    			DashboardId:        "example",
    			Name:               "ci-runner",
    			VersionDescription: "example",
    			Tags:               map[string]string{"managed-by": "ubx"},
    			ThemeArn:           "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ci",
    		})
    	}))
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="TypeScript">
    ```typescript
    import { intent, resource, stack } from "@ubx/sdk";
    import { Dashboard } from "jsr:@ubx/sdk-aws/aws/quicksight/dashboard";

    export default stack("payments", () => {
      intent({ summary: "payments own dashboard" });

      resource(Dashboard, "ci-runner", {
        dashboardId: "example",
        name: "ci-runner",
        versionDescription: "example",
        tags: { "managed-by": "ubx" },
        themeArn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ci",
      });
    });
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Python">
    ```python
    import ubx_sdk as ubx
    from ubx.aws.quicksight import Dashboard, DashboardConfig

    def describe():
        ubx.intent("payments own dashboard")

        ubx.resource(Dashboard, "ci-runner", DashboardConfig(
            dashboard_id="example",
            name="ci-runner",
            version_description="example",
            tags={"managed-by": "ubx"},
            theme_arn="arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ci",
        ))

    if __name__ == "__main__":
        ubx.run("payments", describe)
    ```
  </Tab>
